confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of South African price levels, not live listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation (especially 3-star and private hostel rooms) and cocktail prices are less certain and vary widely by neighborhood and season. FX is the RBA mid-point from search-result snippets of rba.gov.au for 15 October 2026 at 4pm; the page itself was not directly opened, and a third-party figure of 0.6947 dated 16 October was not used because it is not an RBA observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: South African urban tourist pricing (Johannesburg and Durban levels) adjusted for Cape Town's higher visitor-facing prices in restaurants and hotels. Cocktail and wine anchors are set relative to the beer anchor using typical South African bar-to-draught ratios, since direct knowledge of those prices is weaker.
